mapper.update: UPDATE ${table} SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status_before_trash = status, status = 'DELETED' WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE ${table} SET deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = COALESCE(status_before_trash, 'DRAFT'), status_before_trash = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NOT NULL
